L.definition: unweighted arithmetic mean of six case medians; warmup excluded

engineRtf.definition: actual decoder-call elapsed seconds / submitted 16k PCM seconds; full Engine including energy/VAD/native decoding, not ASR kernel alone or Stop-to-text latency

limits: Content-free structural/timing readback only; private hypotheses remain solely in bound raw files. Semantic quality is reviewed separately.
All 181 planned rows completed, including one marked warmup and 180 measurements; no rows were retried, excluded or replaced in these statistics.
Six medians exceed 1 s; six nearest-rank p95 values satisfy 1.5 s. Complete measurement does not qualify P05/P06 or a final model choice.

TC snapshots prove compatible observed instants, not uninterrupted realtime scheduling, kernel causality or enforcement of each period computation budget. Default production publisher policy is unchanged.
CPU values are publisher-thread user/system CPU counters, not process CPU, RSS or memory peaks. Feed and whole-observed-thread deltas include warmup unless explicitly marked measured only.

Phase wait maxima are aggregated from retained per-run summaries; on-budget publications do not retain every internal wait timestamp, so phase maxima cannot be independently reconstructed from individual publications.
Serialized clock-origin equality and accepted Stop/Text/Engine timing are bound to immutable instrumentation source; raw data does not provide a second independent absolute clock trace.
Each publisher join and final runtime join is explicit. Prior audio-owner quiescence is enforced by the pinned next-start handshake; no separate per-row audio-owner-join flag is claimed.

File replay does not establish real microphone/hotkey/end-to-end acceptance. No statistical causal comparison with earlier invalid v1/v2/v3 runs, no Small-model result, no P06 optimisation or whole-plan acceptance.
A reported median miss is not an invented bar to P06 investigation; required quality, correctness, resource and abort evidence remain separate from this report.
